limitations: These are public wallet addresses, not verified people, account owners, bots, identities, or related-control clusters.

Heuristic events use SHA-256 over known economic fields, slot if present, quote fields and instruction-program label if present; receipt t is excluded. Missing and null known optional fields normalize together. This can falsely merge equal same-slot records and split the same transaction across changed schemas, rounding or missing slots. No transaction identity or instruction-family assurance is supplied.
raw_observations preserves recording multiplicity; heuristic_events is not an exact unique on-chain trade count.
recorded_buy_sol and recorded_sell_sol are the archives sol field, excluding non-SOL quote pairs. Curve and pool fields are not fully verified trader-account gross debit/credit or all-in costs.

recorded_*_paid_sol only includes the PumpSwap recorder paid field, excluding non-SOL quote pairs. It omits network, priority, rent and service costs and lacks instruction-family context; it is not account-verified gross debit.
Missing, invalid and non-SOL amounts remain unknown, never zero. Blank CSV / null JSON means no known amount, while a numerical zero is a known sum.
Paper relationship uses exact meta.mint only. Pool-like asset values are not reinterpreted as mints. Historical mint overlap does not establish buyer behavior at paper signal or execution time.

The archived recorder window ends before the first saved paper entry, giving zero contemporaneous paper-fill coverage. No wallet realized PnL, balance, entry/exit cost basis, holdings, funding history, or profitability can be established from this partial receipt archive.
Creator-as-trader marks exact wallet equality to a recorded creator on the same mint; it does not identify developers, coordinated wallets or intent.
Counts cover this saved recorder sample only. Recorders tracked selected mints and intermittent windows; silence is not proof of no activity.
Repeated receipts inside a source file or across a long receipt span can be duplicate recordings or false heuristic merges; retained multiplicity/source masks do not resolve transaction identity.

Creation records contribute creator/mint associations only; their embedded sol/tok fields are not counted as buy/sell trades, avoiding unverified attribution or double-counting against explicit trade records.
Saved paper positions can include multiple strategy variants or shadow simulations on the same underlying signal; position-row counts are not distinct real-money trades or counterparties.
scope: offline public-safe archived recorder data and saved paper ledger
